name: What is a plea agreement in federal court and should I consider one?

mainEntity.name: What is a plea agreement in federal court and should I consider one?

acceptedAnswer.text: A plea agreement in federal court is a negotiated deal where you plead guilty to a lesser charge or receive a lighter sentence. It’s often considered when evidence is strong—your attorney will advise if it’s in your best interest.heathhydelawyer​
